title: Agent loop never reports done after a failed verify or a provider error (AGENT-4/8): union filesChanged across attempts so a retry that changes nothing is re-verified, and provider/HTTP failures return an execute error flag that ends the run failed
description: Agent loop never reports done after a failed verify or a provider error (AGENT-4/8): union filesChanged across attempts so a retry that changes nothing is re-verified, and provider/HTTP failures return an execute error flag that ends the run failed
acceptance_criteria: A retry after a failed verify that changes no files is verified again and the run ends failed (non-zero exit) when retries run out, never done; filesChanged is the union across attempts; a provider or HTTP failure (bad key, 5xx, network error, malformed reply) sets ExecuteResult.error and runTask ends failed instead of done, with or without the verify gate
